title: PremiumPaymentEvent
description: Canonical, provider-independent premium payment event (version 1.x). Published to the Service Bus queue 'payment-notifications' by the Intake service and to the topic 'premium-payment-events' for downstream consumers. Delivery is at least once and unordered: consumers deduplicate by 'idempotencyKey' and order by status rank (PENDING=0, CAPTURED|FAILED=1, REFUNDED=2), then by 'statusChangedAt'. The event never contains payer personal data. Versioning: 'schemaVersion' is MAJOR.MINOR; minor versions only add optional fields or enum values documented as additive; consumers must ignore unknown fields. A new major version is published on a new topic.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR version of this contract. This schema accepts any 1.x.

eventId.description: Name-based UUID derived from idempotencyKey: identical for every delivery of the same business event.

idempotencyKey.description: Identity of the business event. QUETZAL:<event id> | ANDINA:<transaccion.id>:<estado> | AUSTRAL:<eventId>.

correlationId.description: End-to-end correlation identifier (from the API Manager X-Correlation-Id header, or generated by Intake).

providerEventId.description: Provider event or notification-attempt id of the delivery accepted first.

paymentKey.description: <PROVIDER>:<providerTransactionId>. Used as Payment_Key__c (external id) in Salesforce.

policyNumber.description: Normalized policy number, or null when the provider reference could not be resolved to a policy number of the provider's country.

rawPolicyReference.description: Reference exactly as delivered by the provider (merchant reference, not personal data).

providerStatus.description: Provider's original state or event type, e.g. APROBADA or charge.succeeded.

statusChangedAt.description: Time of the state change at the provider, UTC.

receivedAt.description: Time Intake accepted the notification, UTC.

amount.description: Payment amount in the major unit of the currency, as a decimal string (e.g. '1250.00' MXN, '185000.00' COP, '45990' CLP).

refundedAmount.description: Refunded amount in the major unit (refund events only).

statusReason.description: Provider reason for a failure or reversal (failure_code, motivo_reverso).
